item.title: Eleutheria
item.description: Home of the pirates who took Eri in. She was dropped off around age seven and stayed one to two years.

item.title: Eri
item.description:
Fourteen at the story’s start. A defiant punk – outwardly confident, practical, observant, dry. Secretly the princess of Kraeta.

She refuses to stay blind.

Beyond

Daughter of King Lachesis and Queen Hren. Her father set an anchor on her forehead at age four; it is what unlocks the blink.

item.title: Mello
item.description: Captain of the Pirates of Eleutheria. Weathered, fond, a father-figure. Took Eri in for the King’s seasoning and called her and Burill proper sailors.
